title: Reward-SQL: Boosting Text-to-SQL via Stepwise Execution-Aware Reasoning and Process-Supervised Rewards
bound_sents: The upper bound (Pass@N) shows a nearly linear growth as test-time compute increases, climbing from 65.9\% at the lowest compute level to 76.1\% at the highest compute level.

The gap between the theoretical upper bound and actual PRM@n performance gradually widens as compute increases, indicating untapped potential for further improvement through enhanced selection mechanisms.
